$comment: ADR-028 §1 — the scaffold recipe registry. The ONLY place a create-CLI version, template identifier, manager verb, or support claim for a generated project lives. Read by src/scaffold/recipeRegistry.js (frontend) and src-tauri/src/scaffold_recipes.rs (include_str!). The wizard's compatibility matrix and preview, and the Rust runner's argv, are all projections of this file. Bumping a pin: verify the version is ≥24h old (`npm view <pkg> time --json`, ADR-021 §2), refresh `templateManifests` below from the published package, re-run scripts/scaffold-recipe-evidence.mjs for the affected recipes, and update `coverage`.

@angular/cli.$comment: ADR-028 §3: Angular on the Web wrapper runs the Angular CLI directly (exec route). 21.2.x is pinned, not 22.x: every @angular/cli 22.x requires Node ^22.22.3 || ^24.15.0 || >=26, and Litria's bundled runtime is 24.14.0 (src-tauri/src/lsp/packs/versions.rs NODE_VERSION); 21.2.x accepts >=24.0.0. Bumping the bundled Node past 24.15 unlocks 22.x (release policy: node-hashes.json).

web.$comment: web + angular is an `exec` route (ADR-028 §3): create-vite ships no Angular template and silently falls back to vanilla-ts in non-TTY mode (F1), so Angular runs the Angular CLI itself, pinned — the same thing create-vite's own Angular entry and create-tauri-app's angular template do. `routes` overrides the wrapper route per framework; `template` on an exec route is nominal (no template manifest applies).

templateManifests.$comment: Template identifiers each pinned initializer actually ships, taken from the published package (tarball `template-*` directories for create-vite; the pinned README for create-tauri-app; the @electron-forge/template-* packages for Forge). test/domains/scaffoldRecipes.test.mjs refuses any route whose template is not listed here — the check that would have caught web + angular (F1).

coverage.$comment: ADR-028 §10 / brief §6. One entry per (wrapper, framework, language, manager, platform) that has been exercised. Statuses: verified | covered-by-equivalence | unverified | failing. A combination with no entry is `unverified` and is not selectable; the runner refuses it too. Evidence: scripts/scaffold-recipe-evidence.mjs output, recorded per dependency-change policy Rule 6. Offline routes (blank, python) are covered by the Rust test suite and the owner's live passes and carry no per-manager entries.
